name: l2cap_allocate_cid
prototype: int l2cap_allocate_cid(void *descriptor, void *psm_entry, uint16_t psm, char le)

ownership.argument: CID allocation and channel bind helper; the owner cid counter is a u16 field at *(owner)+24 on this build.

provenance.source: Reads the owner cid counter at *(owner)+24, increments it, skips values <= 0x3F and, when the caller is LE, > 0x7F, then walks the channel list comparing channel+116 to avoid a collision; six call sites.
